When a distribution company looks for an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system that includes robust Sales Force Automation (SFA), the primary goal is bridging field operations (rep tracking, mobile order entry, route planning, real-time inventory visibility) with back-office execution (inventory control, warehouse management, and financials).
Top-tier ERP platforms tailored for distribution handle this combination either through deeply integrated native modules or elite-tier ecosystem connectors.
Top ERP Solutions for Distribution with SFA
Key Features to Evaluate for Distribution SFA
Offline Capabilities:: Field reps often visit warehouses, basements, or rural clients with poor cell service. Ensure the SFA mobile app allows offline order creation and syncs when reconnected.
Inventory & Pricing Transparency:: Reps need to see true available-to-promise (ATP) inventory, tiered volume pricing, and customer-specific discounts instantly.
Route & Visit Planning:: For field-heavy distributors (FMCG, food/beverage), look for integrated GPS check-ins, route optimization, and territory management.
